name: Disc identification
author: Lumen Plugins
description: Names the disc you insert. Audio CDs: album, artist, year, track names and cover from MusicBrainz. DVD, Blu-ray and Video CD: film title and year from the disc label via Wikidata. Sends the CD's disc ID or the disc label to these services. Needs Lumen 0.2.1 or newer.
